def deleteBlocks(self):
    """
    _deleteBlocks_
    Find deletable blocks, then decide if to delete based on:
    Is there an active subscription for dataset or block ?
      If yes => set deleted=2
      If no => next check
    Has transfer to all destinations finished ?
      If yes => request block deletion, approve request, set deleted=1
      If no => do nothing (check again next cycle)
    """
    logging.info("Starting deleteBlocks methods")
    for block in self.blocks:
        if block.has_active_subscription():
            block.deleted = 2
            continue
        if block.transfer_finished():
            block.request_deletion()
            block.approve_request()
            block.deleted = 1
        else:
            logging.info(f"Transfer not finished for block {block.id}, checking next cycle.")
